moves.name: Rapid Jabs
moves.notes: 7 frame startup, then a 34 frame loop for each hit on frames 2-3, then an additional 10 frames of endlag for rapid jab ending

moves.name: Forward Smash
moves.notes: second hit active frames 10-13, 59 frames total with an IASA Frame 50 and does 18% damage

moves.name: Up Smash
moves.notes: first hit is frames 11-15 and does 4% damage, second hit is frames 26-28 and does 2% damage, and hit 3 is frames 41-43 and can do 10% or 9% damage

moves.name: Forward Smash 2
moves.notes: Shield stun: 18 shield hit lag: 8 Adantage: -28

moves.name: Hookshot
moves.notes:
Hook to a wall: 11-19
Jumping from hookwall: 1-8 (depending on how far from the point of hooking you are, or if you're dangling)
Jump duration: 36
Fastfall anytime (unless you air dodged upward)
Landfallspeciallag: 4

moves.name: Bow
moves.notes: total time for full charge+release = 84 frames. 24 frames of endlag upon release. damage increases the longer the charge (will do 1% if very close upon release)

moves.name: Boomerang
moves.notes: boomerang active for 141-171 frames. catch duration 19 frames. can also do 14% damage

moves.name: Boomerang (Air)
moves.notes: boomerang active for 141-171 frames. catch duration 19 frames. can also do 14% damage

moves.name: Spin Attack (Air)
moves.notes: 5 total hits, first can do 4 or 6%, next 3 do 2%, last one can do 4 or 6%

moves.name: Bomb
moves.notes: bomb duration from end of pull (startup) is 277 frames

moves.name: Bomb (Air)
moves.notes: bomb duration from end of pull (startup) is 277 frames

moves.name: Grab
moves.notes: First hitbox is a hand grab which is frame 11-13, grapple is from 11-17

moves.name: Dash Grab
moves.notes: Hook hitbox from frame 12-17, close grab only on frame 12.
